say:0:1111513401:0.text: Merlin! Come forth... I have been longing for this moment.
say:0:1111513401:0.source_cn: 梅林！来……来吧！我是如此迫切地与你相见！
say:0:1111513401:0.male: Merlin! Come forth... I have been longing for this moment.
say:0:1111513401:0.female: Merlin! Come forth... I have been longing for this moment.

say:1:1111513402:0.text: Where's this voice coming from? How do they know the Magister's true identity?!
say:1:1111513402:0.source_cn: 竟然说出了主人的身份！这声音的源头到底从哪来？
say:1:1111513402:0.male: Where's this voice coming from? How do they know the Magister's true identity?!
say:1:1111513402:0.female: Where's this voice coming from? How do they know the Magister's true identity?!

say:2:1111513403:0.text: Down there! At the end of this long, dark staircase!
say:2:1111513403:0.source_cn: 在下面！在这漫长而幽深的长阶尽头！
